name: MonarchConnectedAppsList
title: ConnectedAppsList
wrapsNative: VStack of rows with dividers; alert(_:isPresented:presenting:actions:message:) with Button(role: .destructive) to confirm removal; RelativeDateTimeFormatter for times; redacted(reason: .placeholder) while loading
summary: The apps a person signed in to with their account: logo, name, domain, verified or suspended badges, when it was connected and last used, the workspace and what it can access, with Remove access behind a confirmation.
whenToUse: On an account's security or privacy settings screen, so people can see which apps use their account and remove access.
whenNotToUse: Not for the devices or browsers signed in to the account, and not for third-party integrations a workspace installs; use a plain List for those.
api: init(_ apps: [MonarchConnectedApp], state: MonarchConnectedAppsListState = .ready, title: String? = nil, description: String? = nil, isRetrying: Bool = false, confirmsRevoke: Bool = true, now: Date? = nil, labels: MonarchConnectedAppsListLabels = MonarchConnectedAppsListLabels(), onRetry: (@MainActor () -> Void)? = nil, onRevoke: (@MainActor (MonarchConnectedApp) async throws -> Void)? = nil)

struct MonarchConnectedApp: Identifiable { init(id: String, name: String, logoURL: URL? = nil, domain: String? = nil, isVerified: Bool = false, isSuspended: Bool = false, workspace: String? = nil, scopes: [String] = [], connectedAt: Date? = nil, lastUsedAt: Date? = nil) }
enum MonarchConnectedAppsListState { case ready, loading, error }

options.name: apps
options.description: The connected apps, each with a name, optional logo URL, domain, verified and suspended flags, workspace, scopes in plain words, and connected and last-used dates.

options.name: state
options.description: ready shows the rows, or the empty state when there are none; loading shows placeholder rows; error shows MonarchErrorState.

options.name: title
options.description: Replaces "Connected apps". An empty string hides the header.

options.name: description
options.description: Replaces the line under the title.

options.name: isRetrying
options.description: Shows the retry in progress in the error state.

options.name: confirmsRevoke
options.description: Asks before removing access. Turn it off when the app shows its own confirmation from onRevoke.

options.name: now
options.description: The reference time for "3 days ago". The current time by default.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Retries loading. Adds a retry button to the error state.

options.name: onRevoke
options.description: Removes an app's access and the app from apps. Adds Remove access to every row; the button shows progress while it runs. A thrown error's description is shown under the row and announced.

states.name: ready
states.description: The rows on a surface with a subtle border, separated by dividers.

states.name: loading
states.description: Two redacted placeholder rows, read as one "Loading connected apps" element.

states.name: error
states.description: A small MonarchErrorState with a retry button when onRetry is given.

states.name: removing
states.description: The row's Remove access button shows progress.

states.name: removal failed
states.description: An icon and the error's description in the danger strong colour under the row.

states.name: suspended app
states.description: The name is muted and a warning Suspended badge follows it.

appearance: Rows sit on the surface background with a subtle border. Logos are MonarchFavicons with a letter fallback. Names are body strong; domain and times are muted captions; scopes are captions with a check mark. Verified is a success badge with a check mark, Suspended a warning badge. Remove access is a small danger MonarchButton. All colours are theme roles, so dark and high-contrast themes follow.
platformNotes: The confirmation is the system alert with a destructive button instead of the web's ConfirmDialog. The web's SectionCard is MonarchSectionHeader with a bordered surface. The web passes the id to onRevoke; iOS passes the whole app value. The logo is a URL only (no local Image), because the app value is Sendable data. The web's headingLevel has no equivalent: the title has the header trait. The web's danger-subtle button variant does not exist on iOS; the danger variant is used. Several closures are optional (onRetry, onRevoke). Pass each one with its label: Swift gives a single unlabelled trailing closure to the first parameter that accepts it, which is onRetry.
accessibility: The title is a header, from MonarchSectionHeader.
Each app's name, badges, domain, times and workspace are one element: the name as its label and the rest as its value.
Each scope list is a group named "What Notes can access".
Remove access is a standard button named "Remove access for Notes" with a 44-point touch target; the confirmation is a system alert.
Removal and failures are announced; a failure is also shown with an icon and text.
Badges are words, so the verified and suspended states do not depend on colour.
edgeCases: A logo that fails to load shows the first letter of the name.
An app with no dates, domain or scopes shows only its name and badges.
Two removals can run at once; each row tracks its own progress.
Long names wrap; badges move to the next line.

examples.setupTemplate:
@State private var apps = [
    MonarchConnectedApp(
        id: {{apps.0.id}},
        name: {{apps.0.name}},
        domain: {{apps.0.domain}},
        isVerified: {{apps.0.verified}},
        workspace: {{apps.0.workspace}},
        scopes: [{{apps.0.scopes.0}}, {{apps.0.scopes.1}}],
        connectedAt: Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: -86_400 * {{apps.0.connectedDaysAgo}}),
        lastUsedAt: Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: -86_400 * {{apps.0.lastUsedDaysAgo}})
    ),
    MonarchConnectedApp(
        id: {{apps.1.id}},
        name: {{apps.1.name}},
        domain: {{apps.1.domain}},
        scopes: [{{apps.1.scopes.0}}],
        connectedAt: Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: -86_400 * {{apps.1.connectedDaysAgo}}),
        lastUsedAt: Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: -86_400 * {{apps.1.lastUsedDaysAgo}})
    ),
    MonarchConnectedApp(
        id: {{apps.2.id}},
        name: {{apps.2.name}},
        isSuspended: {{apps.2.suspended}},
        connectedAt: Date(timeIntervalSinceNow: -86_400 * {{apps.2.connectedDaysAgo}})
    ),
]
